archetypes.name: dyn-design-prose
archetypes.rationale: Review lazy-loaded /design prose relocation without behavior drift.
archetypes.prompt_body: Focus on the changed /design prompt and reference prose. Verify that SKILL.md now keeps only routing pointers while finalize-step5.md and sentinel-host-table.md carry the moved details. Check that no sentinel host table rows or operational wait instructions changed. Flag any duplicated always-loaded prose or lost failure-reporting ownership details. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
